subject: Discovery recap + one quick question
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ian Cole <ian.cole@clearbridgelogistics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + one quick question

Hi Ian —

Really appreciated your time today. Quick recap of what we discussed and a single ask: is this list of priorities accurate for your team?

Summary (very short):
- Primary objective: speed up routing decisions for regional hubs (sub-100ms inference for packing suggestions).
- Constraints: strict PII controls, VPC-only deployment preferred, existing models on Triton today.
- Success metric: 15% reduction in misrouted pallets and measurable latency improvement for the inference path.

Next steps I proposed:
1) 2-week pilot using Redwood Dedicated on a small sample of SKUs (we estimate 50k inference calls/day).
2) Security questionnaire + short SOC2 evidence exchange.
3) Alignment call with your infra lead to validate VPC network needs.

Attachment: redwood-quick-proposal.pdf (1 page — high level pilot plan + estimated tokenized cost)

One quick question for you: does this feel like something you would prioritize inside Q1, or is the timing likely later? A one-line answer is totally fine — helps me set expectations on our side.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Ian —

Wanted to follow up on my note below in case it got buried. I realize schedules are hectic — if it helps, two quick options:

A) If this is still in-scope for Q1, would you be open to a 20-minute sync next week to lock the pilot scope?
B) If the timing is pushed, would you tell me the expected quarter so we don't ping too often?

Ben (cc'd) is available to join a brief technical alignment if you want to include infra folks — he can cover deployment/latency tradeoffs.

If neither option fits, a one-line ‘later’ or ‘not a fit’ works fine. Appreciate the quick signal.

Best,
Neha
